registryArtifactVerification.purpose: Issue #172's clean public-registry installation verification, independent of qualification's saved build artifacts: 'Clean public-registry installs exercise each published interface, all exact supported framework versions, join regressions and unsupported/prerelease refusal.'

checks.pythonSmoke: scripts/smoke_langgraph_installation.py passed against both supported langgraph versions (1.2.10, 1.2.11), each installed exclusively from public PyPI
checks.pythonBehavior: Repeated/permuted join-declaration dedup and declare_children depth 0/1/2 evidence (including the agt describe --depth --strict CLI path) reproduced exactly against the registry-installed wheel
checks.pythonRefusal: Both the library call and the agt CLI refused langgraph==1.2.9 (the adjacent unsupported patch) with UnsupportedLangGraphVersionError / exit code 5, naming the exact tested versions
checks.typescriptSmoke: scripts/smoke_typescript_installation.mjs passed against tarballs downloaded live via npm pack from the public registry (spec alone, producer with peer, and coexistence scenarios; ESM/CommonJS export-boundary checks)
checks.typescriptBehavior: Repeated/permuted join-declaration dedup, delimiter-escaping for +/\ -bearing source ids, and canonicalStringify reproduced exactly against the registry-installed tarball
checks.typescriptRefusal: describe() refused the real published prerelease @langchain/langgraph@1.4.15-rc.0 (forced to a single deduped copy via npm overrides, since the producer pins @langchain/langgraph as a regular dependency) with UnsupportedLangGraphVersionError

registryArtifactVerification.outcome: All 9 checks passed against artifacts installed exclusively from the real public PyPI and npm registries, with no local path, workspace link, editable install, or --find-links used anywhere. Full detail, commands, and per-check logs: docs/releases/evidence/beta.5/publication-install-verification.json and its sibling ts-registry-*/python-registry-*.log files.
